description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
- Press Normal Attack right after casting the skill to perform Basic Attack Stage 3 directly.

Heavy Attack - Razor Wind

Hold Normal Attack after casting Basic Attack Stage 3, Dodge Counter, or Heavy Attack to cast Heavy Attack Razor Wind. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
- Press Normal Attack shortly after landing to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.
- At max Windstrings, press Normal Attack shortly after landing to cast Resonance Skill Unbound Flow.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
- Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah melancarkan skill untuk langsung melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Heavy Attack - Razor Wind

Tahan Normal Attack setelah melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3, Dodge Counter, atau Heavy Attack untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack Razor Wind. Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack, memberikan Aero DMG.
- Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah mendarat untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 4.
- Saat Windstring maksimal, tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah mendarat untuk melancarkan Resonance Skill Unbound Flow.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
Awakening Gale

Jump up into the mid-air and slash the target, dealing Aero DMG.

Skyfall Severance

While in mid-air, press Resonance Skill to deal Aero DMG, which removes all stacks of Spectro Frazzle, Havoc Bane, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, and Electro Flare from the target hit and inflicts 1 stack of Aero Erosion for each stack removed.
description.id:
Awakening Gale

Melompat ke udara dan menebas target, memberikan Aero DMG.

Skyfall Severance

Saat di udara, tekan Resonance Skill untuk memberikan Aero DMG, yang menghapus seluruh stack Spectro Frazzle, Havoc Bane, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, dan Electro Flare dari target yang terkena dan memberikan 1 stack Aero Erosion untuk setiap stack yang dihapus.

description.en:
Unleash the power of the Eye of Tempest, dealing Aero DMG and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
description.id:
Melepaskan kekuatan Eye of Tempest, memberikan Aero DMG dan memulihkan HP seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim.
Dapat dilancarkan di udara dekat tanah.

description.en: Casting Intro Skill Relentless Squall increases ATK by 20% for 10s.
description.id: Melancarkan Intro Skill Relentless Squall meningkatkan ATK sebesar 20% selama 10 dtk.

description.en: Increase Healing from Resonance Liberation Omega Storm by 20%.
description.id: Meningkatkan Healing dari Resonance Liberation Omega Storm sebesar 20%.

description.en:
Mid-air Attack - Cloudburst Dance

Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and healing all nearby Resonators in the team. Cast through the following 3 ways:
- Press Normal Attack right after casting Resonance Skill Awakening Gale.
- Press Normal Attack right after casting Intro Skill.
- Press Normal Attack right after casting Heavy Attack Razor Wind.
When casting Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance, hold Normal Attack to perform Mid-air Attack.

Resonance Skill - Unbound Flow

At max Windstrings, Resonance Skill Awakening Gale becomes Resonance Skill Unbound Flow: Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks. Each attack consumes 60 Windstrings, dealing Aero DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Switching to another Resonator after Stage 1 automatically triggers Stage 2 of this skill.

Windstring

Rover can hold up to 120 Windstrings.
Each stage of Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance restores 25 Windstrings on hit.
Casting Intro Skill restores 20 Windstrings.
Hitting a target with Basic Attack Stage 3 or 4 or Dodge Counter restores 10 Windstrings.
description.id:
Mid-air Attack - Cloudburst Dance

Melakukan hingga 2 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG (dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG) dan memulihkan HP seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim. Dilancarkan melalui 3 cara berikut:
- Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Awakening Gale.
- Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah melancarkan Intro Skill.
- Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack Razor Wind.
Saat melancarkan Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance, tahan Normal Attack untuk melakukan Mid-air Attack.

Resonance Skill - Unbound Flow

Saat Windstring maksimal, Resonance Skill Awakening Gale berubah menjadi Resonance Skill Unbound Flow: Melakukan hingga 2 serangan beruntun. Setiap serangan mengonsumsi 60 Windstring, memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Skill DMG.
Berganti ke Resonator lain setelah Tahap 1 otomatis memicu Tahap 2 dari skill ini.

Windstring

Rover dapat menyimpan hingga 120 Windstring.
Setiap tahap Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance memulihkan 25 Windstring saat mengenai target.
Melancarkan Intro Skill memulihkan 20 Windstring.
Mengenai target dengan Basic Attack Tahap 3 atau 4 atau Dodge Counter memulihkan 10 Windstring.

attributes.name: Unbound Flow Concerto Regen per Stage

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en:
Grant Aeolian Realm to all nearby Resonators in the team for 30s. Aeolian Realm effect:
- Upon hitting a target, increase the maximum stack of Aero Erosion the target can receive by 3 for 10s. This effect is not stackable.
description.id:
Memberikan Aeolian Realm kepada seluruh Resonator di sekitar dalam tim selama 30 dtk. Efek Aeolian Realm:
- Saat mengenai target, meningkatkan stack maksimum Aero Erosion yang dapat diterima target sebanyak 3 selama 10 dtk. Efek ini tidak dapat ditumpuk.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Casting Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance enhances Rover's resistance to interruption for 3s.
description.id: Melancarkan Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance meningkatkan ketahanan Rover terhadap interupsi selama 3 dtk.

description.en: Casting Resonance Skill Unbound Flow continuously restores HP for the Resonator on the field by 20% of Rover's ATK every 3s for 30s. When the Resonator on the field has an HP lower than 35%, immediately restore 10% of their lost HP. This restoration effect can be triggered once every 10s and will not be affected by any Healing Bonus.
description.id: Melancarkan Resonance Skill Unbound Flow terus memulihkan HP Resonator yang sedang di lapangan sebesar 20% ATK Rover setiap 3 dtk selama 30 dtk. Saat HP Resonator di lapangan di bawah 35%, langsung memulihkan 10% dari HP yang hilang. Efek pemulihan ini dapat dipicu sekali setiap 10 dtk dan tidak dipengaruhi Healing Bonus apa pun.

description.en: Aero DMG Bonus is increased by 15%.
Casting Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance increases Resonance Skill DMG Bonus by 15% for 5s.
description.id: Melancarkan Mid-air Attack Cloudburst Dance meningkatkan Resonance Skill DMG Bonus sebesar 15% selama 5 dtk.

description.en: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Omega Storm is increased by 20%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Omega Storm meningkat sebesar 20%.

description.en: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Unbound Flow is increased by 30%.
description.id: Pengali DMG Resonance Skill Unbound Flow meningkat sebesar 30%.
